scope: HR/people, personal effectiveness, career, study and education recipes and related agent branches
method: Read each distinct component governing method/system prompt, required inputs, output contract, hard rules and stated limitations. Checked those against recipe intake, notes, promised result and agent branches. Repeated bibliography and long illustrative examples were not independently fact-checked. This is source-level semantic review, not model execution, clinical/legal review or proof of learning/business outcomes.

agents_reviewed.name: Weekly team coverage review assistant
agents_reviewed.branch: Run the coverage workflow for the changed window. If capacity is short, run team-capacity-planner and present defer, reduce or add-cover options for the manager.
agents_reviewed.method_review: Reviewed source IDs/version comparison, trigger, branching, minimal state, two-pass correction cap, missing-evidence stop, no automatic schedule, and authorization/readback boundaries. Study checks need real learner answers; other branches use actual supplied business records.

agents_reviewed.name: Employee feedback action review assistant
agents_reviewed.branch: Run the listening workflow for new themes. For existing actions, use executive-action-register to compare evidence with the agreed commitments and draft only the changed update.
agents_reviewed.method_review: Reviewed source IDs/version comparison, trigger, branching, minimal state, two-pass correction cap, missing-evidence stop, no automatic schedule, and authorization/readback boundaries. Study checks need real learner answers; other branches use actual supplied business records.

agents_reviewed.name: Job application evidence review assistant
agents_reviewed.branch: Run the application workflow. If an assertion lacks support, ask for the actual evidence or remove it; use proofreader for at most two revision passes, then list any remaining issues. Never submit the application from this review alone.
agents_reviewed.method_review: Reviewed source IDs/version comparison, trigger, branching, minimal state, two-pass correction cap, missing-evidence stop, no automatic schedule, and authorization/readback boundaries. Study checks need real learner answers; other branches use actual supplied business records.

agents_reviewed.name: Study plan progress review assistant
agents_reviewed.branch: Use study-understanding-check on the learner actual recent answers. When the learner is absent, review only supplied answers and prepare an unrun next check; never invent responses or mastery. Keep successful parts of the plan; rerun the study planning workflow only for missed prerequisites, persistent errors or changed time. Mark the review incomplete if no practice evidence is available.
agents_reviewed.method_review: Reviewed source IDs/version comparison, trigger, branching, minimal state, two-pass correction cap, missing-evidence stop, no automatic schedule, and authorization/readback boundaries. Study checks need real learner answers; other branches use actual supplied business records.

records.applicability: HR career ladders, progression criteria, employee-owned development and promotion readiness conversations fit the promotion brief.
records.prerequisites_and_limits: Requires actual employee goals and job evidence; development recommendations remain proposals.

records.applicability: Genuine partner-identified need, curriculum/service integration, reciprocity, reflection and separate civic/academic assessment fit service learning.

used_by.workflow: Prepare a confidential conflict discussion

used_by.workflow: Make a realistic plan for a busy week

used_by.workflow: Prepare a fair promotion discussion
used_by.note: Prepare a discussion that states the evidence, unresolved questions and next review point.

records.prerequisites_and_limits: Needs actual behavior and prior discussions; true praise may be missing. Do not infer motives or force praise. Neutral mediation remains the mediation component job.

used_by.workflow: Build a practice plan from common mistakes

records.applicability: Creates one realistic deliberate error per example with diagnosis scaffold and separate correct teacher version.
records.prerequisites_and_limits: Students must see correct models first. Keep deliberate errors clearly labeled and separate teacher answers; never teach the error as truth.

used_by.workflow: Prepare a team absence handover
used_by.note: Write task-level handovers with source links, current state and the next action.

records.applicability: Actual work dump, successor/window, urgent dates, task state, locations and access process form a practical leave handover.
records.prerequisites_and_limits: Requires the real cover owner and source facts. Missing cover is a gap; credentials must never appear and contact preferences are not inferred.

used_by.workflow: Plan a difficult feedback conversation
used_by.note: Draft a direct opening grounded in evidence and a clear, fair request.

records.applicability: Observed behavior, true praise, direct fair request and a face-saving response fit a difficult-message opening.
records.prerequisites_and_limits: Requires actual examples, audience and requested change. Does not invent receiver reactions or praise.

used_by.workflow: Plan a peer feedback session that helps

records.applicability: Reads whole draft, notes engagement/drift, specific strengths, scene/section purpose and line-level questions.
records.prerequisites_and_limits: Method is creative/literary critique, not arbitrary mathematics marking. Narrow to relevant writing drafts; owner retains revision choice.

used_by.workflow: Compare HR software before buying

records.applicability: Actual HR AI evaluation covers use-case-specific accuracy, fairness, transparency, privacy and pilot questions.
records.prerequisites_and_limits: Vendor claims are not evidence; pilot or fairness results are not inferred from brochures.

records.applicability: Actual HR vendor lifecycle covers RFP criteria, data protection, pricing, integration, exit and migration.

records.applicability: Actual HR leadership program and competency design cover new-manager training with assessment and follow-through.
records.prerequisites_and_limits: Calibrate learning objective to the stated management task and participant experience.

used_by.note: Plan observations of learner decisions for teacher planning. Keep this documentation distinct from the separate curriculum assessment.

used_by.note: Offer different ways to access, practice and demonstrate the same learning.
